_comment: Inventory of the features README.md names, enforced by scripts/check-feature-drift.mjs. CONTRACT (decided as D3 in the v2.4.9 plan, 2026-09-10, and documented in docs/reference/feature-inventory.md): CI enforces exactly two things per entry -- the `evidence` path resolves, and `name` appears verbatim in the README region named by `region`. The `status`, `testedAt` and `verificationCommand` fields are ADVISORY: they record how a feature was last verified and are never executed by the drift checker, because shelling out to every command would be a full test run wearing an inventory's clothes. There is deliberately NO version field: it read v0.8.0 while package.json read 2.4.1, and semantic-release bumps package.json on main without touching this file, so a gating version assertion would break main from inside a release commit. Read the version from package.json instead.

features.name: Agentic AI Coding
features.description: Tool-using coding agent runtime: plan mode, auto mode, sub-agents, and the verification gates around them.

features.name: Local Chatbot Explorer
features.description: Desktop chat pillar with a folder-tree explorer over local sessions, attachments, and archives.

features.name: Image Studio
features.description: Desktop image-generation pillar driving the diffusion runtime, with a model-bounded settings surface.

features.name: Video Lab
features.description: Desktop video-generation pillar driving the diffusion runtime's video pipelines.

features.name: Document parsing (OCR)
features.description: Document-OCR runtime: a portable CPU tier (pypdfium2 + RapidOCR) and an optional NVIDIA quality tier.

features.name: Local API server (opt-in)
features.description: Opt-in loopback OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible gateway so other local tools reuse installed models. Default off.

features.name: Ask inbox and scheduled runs (opt-in)
features.description: Persistent local approval queue for headless and scheduled runs. No auto-approve.

features.name: MLX on Apple Silicon (via local adapters)
features.description: Apple Silicon MLX servers registered as local adapters. No bundled MLX runtime.

features.name: llama.cpp on loopback (via local adapters)
features.description: A user-started llama-server on loopback registered as a local adapter. No bundled runtime.

features.name: Always-on telemetry
features.description: Local telemetry bus feeding the GPU/VRAM surfaces and the energy estimator. Local-only; no outbound sink.

features.name: Plan mode
features.description: Slash-command planning mode: produce a Markdown plan, then walk each step with explicit state.

features.name: Auto mode
features.description: End-to-end tool-using sessions with verification gates and git checkpoints.

features.name: Four-layer memory
features.description: Working / episodic / semantic / graph layers with per-tier half-lives and a scope-aware retriever.

features.name: Hybrid retrieval
features.description: BM25 plus dense plus graph retrieval fused by Reciprocal Rank Fusion.

features.name: Session replay
features.description: Timeline scrubber and compare-two-sessions diff view in the Trace dashboard.

features.name: Skill harness
features.description: Nexus-Hub catalog synced into a single-home catalog directory, hot-reloaded, with an allowlist and an injection scanner on install.

features.name: Skill self-optimization
features.description: Golden-task-graded, held-out-validated, human-approved bounded edits to skills. Opt-in and default off.

features.name: Per-model harness selection
features.description: Auto-tunes the agent scaffold profile per local model with a golden A/B. Opt-in.

features.name: MLX via local adapters
features.description: Apple Silicon MLX servers registered as local adapters. No bundled MLX runtime.

features.name: llama.cpp via local adapters
features.description: A user-started llama-server on loopback registered as a local adapter. Does not open the patient-tier gate.

features.name: Local API server
features.description: Opt-in loopback gateway, with ACP mounted on the same listener and token. Unattended confirms park in the ask inbox.

features.name: Ask inbox + scheduler
features.description: Local approval queue plus a cron-style scheduler. Morning brief off by default.

features.name: Document parsing
features.description: Optional OCR models for PDF and image, plus native DOCX/PPTX/XLSX without them. Docling not required.

features.name: Motion identity
features.description: Internal orbs, beam, and metal on the desktop shell. One winner per surface; honors OS reduced-motion by halting.

features.name: Slash commands
features.description: Built-in memory and planning slash commands plus the skill-backed catalog with preferUpstream ordering.

features.name: GPU scheduler
features.description: Prioritizes coding token generation over background diffusion when both want the same GPU. Tier-aware.

features.name: MCP support
features.description: Stdio MCP servers via the per-project registry, under a reverse-engineering-first policy with per-tool deny.

features.name: Trace dashboard
features.description: Tool spans, hook filter, session side-rail, replay scrubber, and side-by-side compare.

features.name: Operation log
features.description: Opt-in append-only Markdown line per tool call, with a secret-path denylist applied before write.
